title: Shortest Path With At Most K Consecutive Identical Characters
summary: Find a minimum-weight directed path from vertex zero to n-1 such that the node-label string along the path has no run longer than k of an identical character. Include the starting node's label. Return -1 if no valid path exists.
officialConstraints: 1..50000 vertices; 0..50000 directed non-self edges; weights 1..10000; lowercase node labels; k 1..50.
exampleStatus: Author and independently check examples; no source examples copied into public presets.
